title: Stepwise azido transfer to cerous tris(tert-butoxy)siloxide via trans-silylation with Me3SiN3

synthesis.procedure: A slurry of [Ce{OSi(OtBu)3}3]2 in n-hexane was treated with one equivalent of Me3SiN3, giving a clear colourless solution. The silyl ether side-product Me3SiOSi(OtBu)3 was removed by recrystallization from toluene at −40 °C, affording crystalline 1. In non-coordinating solvents, slow ligand rearrangement to 2 was observed.

synthesis.procedure: Treatment of [Ce{OSi(OtBu)3}3]2 with two equivalents of Me3SiN3 in n-hexane led to complete dissolution of the cerous siloxide upon stirring overnight. Recrystallization from toluene at −40 °C separated the silyl ether side-product and gave pure crystalline 2, structurally a tetrametallic complex [Ce4{OSi(OtBu)3}4{μ2-OSi(OtBu)3}4(μ2-N3)3(μ4-N3)].
